subject.title: Add high-contrast mode for inactive displays

question: Should CodexBar permanently add this opt-in inactive-display contrast preference, scoped to the Icon & percent menu bar style?
rationale: The branch is technically credible and default-safe, but it adds persistent settings and localized product surface without maintainer confirmation; the linked issue is already marked as needing that decision.

options.title: Approve the style-scoped option
options.body: Accept the opt-in preference after disabling or hiding it for menu bar styles that do not use the attributed renderer.

options.title: Prefer automatic behavior
options.body: Request an automatic policy or broader renderer before adding a user-facing preference.

options.title: Decline the new setting
options.body: Keep native AppKit rendering only and close the linked feature request despite the demonstrated inactive-display readability gain.

recommendation.title: Approve the style-scoped option
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in preference after disabling or hiding it for menu bar styles that do not use the attributed renderer.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent status-item display work and final landing decisions route most strongly to the repository owner.
